name: update_plan
description: Update the plan (todos.md) or record a finding (findings.md). target='plan': create or revise the task plan. target='findings': append a fact or discovery to findings.md.

target.description: plan: operate on todos.md. findings: append content to findings.md.

action.description: (target=plan) create: write new todos.md. revise: replace a failed task with replacement tasks and record the failure.

plan.description: (target=plan, action=create) Full todos.md content to write.

failed_task.description: (target=plan, action=revise) Text of the failed task as it appears after '- [ ]' in todos.md.

tried.description: (target=plan, action=revise) What was attempted and why it failed — recorded as a '- ✗' line in the plan.

replacement_tasks.description: (target=plan, action=revise) Newline-separated replacement tasks to insert. Include '[decomposed] ' prefix where appropriate.

content.description: (target=findings) The fact or discovery to record.

execution.command_template:
printf '%s\x00%s\x00%s\x00%s\x00%s\x00%s\x00%s' '{{target}}' '{{action}}' '{{plan}}' '{{failed_task}}' '{{tried}}' '{{replacement_tasks}}' '{{content}}' | python3 -c "
import sys, re
data = sys.stdin.read()
parts = data.split('\x00')
target = parts[0] if len(parts) > 0 else ''
action = parts[1] if len(parts) > 1 else ''
plan = parts[2] if len(parts) > 2 else ''
failed_task = parts[3] if len(parts) > 3 else ''
tried = parts[4] if len(parts) > 4 else ''
replacement_tasks = parts[5] if len(parts) > 5 else ''
content = parts[6] if len(parts) > 6 else ''
if target == 'findings':
    with open('findings.md', 'a') as f:
        f.write('- ' + content.strip() + '\n')
    print('Finding recorded.')
elif target == 'plan':
    if action == 'create':
        open('todos.md', 'w').write(plan.strip() + '\n')
        print('Plan created.')
    elif action == 'revise':
        try:
            lines = open('todos.md').readlines()
        except FileNotFoundError:
            print('todos.md not found', file=sys.stderr)
            sys.exit(1)
        target_task = failed_task.strip()
        idx = None
        for i, line in enumerate(lines):
            if line.strip().startswith('- [ ]') and target_task in line:
                idx = i
                break
        if idx is None:
            print('Task not found: ' + target_task, file=sys.stderr)
            sys.exit(1)
        task_text = re.sub(r'^-\s*\[.\]\s*', '', lines[idx].strip())
        new_lines = []
        for task in replacement_tasks.strip().split('\n'):
            task = task.strip()
            if task:
                new_lines.append('- [ ] ' + task + '\n')
        new_lines.append('- \u2717 ' + task_text + ' \u2014 ' + tried.strip() + '\n')
        lines = lines[:idx] + new_lines + lines[idx+1:]
        open('todos.md', 'w').writelines(lines)
        print('Plan revised: ' + str(len(new_lines)-1) + ' replacement task(s) added, failure recorded.')
    else:
        print('Unknown action: ' + action, file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
else:
    print('Unknown target: ' + target, file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)
"
